lines.text: The Eiffel Tower gets taller every summer.
And that's not even the strangest part.
It's built from about seven thousand three hundred tonnes of iron.
lines.caption: It's built from about 7,300 tonnes of iron.

lines.text: And iron grows when it gets hot.
From the coldest winter day to the hottest summer day, the tower can grow up to fifteen centimeters.
lines.caption: From the coldest winter day to the hottest summer day, the tower can grow up to 15 centimeters.

lines.text: And the strangest part? On sunny days, the sunny side expands more, so the whole tower leans slightly away from the sun.
Sounds fake? It's true. Follow for more.
